strengths: Japan is not cash-only is structural, not a footnote
Regional/shop variation (bakery, shrine, PayPay-not-Visa) avoids a national personality
Ritual money is treated as object-and-envelope, not mystical love of paper

issues.location: Low everyday crime, high everyday caution
issues.problem: Even hedged, safety-as-reason-to-carry-cash can echo the national-safety myth.
issues.suggestion: Keep the phone-failure contrast; do not expand street-crime as character.
